laravelToNextJs.blade: - Be extra careful about transpiling any ajax jquery calls into axios calls, and SSR calls using my backend in Django - Use the following UI library/libraries for styling: Material UI and Tailwind - Use the following library for toasts: Sweetalert2 - Pay close attention to the fact that if the component has tags typical of a HTMLHeadElement or a tag of HTMLBodyElement, then it is a page, and should be split into layout.tsx and page.tsx; else it's just a component, and should be written as such - The naming convention should follow this patterns examples: employee/create = EmployeeCreate / bug/edit = BugEdit - None of the modules presented are root layout or pages, so no need to reimplement HTMLHtmlElement or HTMLBodyElement; - Considering I'm working with SSR under the App router, render as much as possible serverside (without compromising styling or functionality), and isolate the clientside components;
